issues_encountered: The original six-second Groq gap was insufficient for the observed 8,000-token rate-limit bucket. All failures remain in results.json; no retries replaced them.
The initial repair browser harness used an insecure blank page; it was corrected to use localhost before freezing the candidate.
The report browser harness initially assumed a heading's accessible whitespace and an incorrect initial keyboard-focus position; the harness was corrected and passed without product changes.
Linux ffmpeg was unavailable. Synthetic fixtures were normalized using the already installed Windows ffmpeg; audio hashes and intended scripts are retained.
Git may convert CRLF on deployment. A verifier distinguishes exact LF/CRLF conversion from code changes without changing the original freeze or evaluation results.
limitations: Assistant-authored expectations are provisional until independent review. No human-review accuracy is claimed.
One synthetic voice and intended script references do not establish real-learner speech performance. No actual learner corrections have been collected.
The baseline is the same Groq model with a general-assistant prompt, not the ChatGPT product.
Finite tests on four pure JavaScript functions do not establish arbitrary-project correctness.
